fixture_limits: the model is scripted: the tool steps and the text reply each turn are fixed by the driver; a refusal is proven by Construct's tool result and by the one publish call in that turn, not by model reasoning
the scratch checks are real GitHub-hosted Actions jobs started by the push and the pull request; the driver waits for them to complete and records their conclusions

the credential store holds the local gh user token (repo scope), not a fine-grained token restricted to the scratch repository: fine-grained tokens can only be minted in the web UI. The token never leaves the host store; the harness uses the same account's gh auth to verify GitHub
the pull request number and commit shas come from the turns; reruns reuse the scratch repository
the scratch repository is public and the project file opts in to own-branch writes (ADR 0008 §3): the default-scope cases exercise that explicit opt-in, not the private-repository inference
